tools.name: discover_site_resources
tools.description: Return the public machine-readable discovery resources for this website, including llms.txt, sitemap, API catalog, ARD manifest and Agent Skills index.

tools.name: list_product_categories
tools.description: List public WooCommerce product categories with their IDs, names, slugs, item counts and images when available.

limit.description: Maximum number of categories to return.

tools.name: read_current_page_as_markdown
tools.description: Retrieve the current public WordPress page through the site's Markdown content negotiation. Use this to read supported pages, posts, products and product categories in a clean machine-readable form.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the public WooCommerce product catalog by text. Returns a compact list of matching products with canonical URLs, SKU, prices and stock state when available.

query.description: Text to search for in the public product catalog.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.
